# watchpoint_tenant_security_settings (Resource)

Tenant-wide sign-in security: MFA enforcement, the idle session timeout and the tenant IP allowlist, which applies to both sign-in and API keys. A per-tenant singleton: declare it at most once. Requires `settings.manage`. **Enabling the allowlist without the address Terraform runs from locks that run out**; include your CI egress range. Destroying the resource leaves the settings as they are rather than silently widening access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Require MFA for every member and limit sign-in and API-key use to the office
# and VPN ranges. Declare this resource once per tenant.
resource "watchpoint_tenant_security_settings" "this" {
  enforce_mfa             = true
  ip_allowlist_enabled    = true
  allowed_ip_ranges       = ["203.0.113.0/24", "2001:db8::/48"]
  session_timeout_minutes = 120
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allowed_ip_ranges` (Set of String) IPv4/IPv6 CIDR ranges (a bare address is a single host). Validated by the API.
- `enforce_mfa` (Boolean) Require every member to enrol in MFA before using the portal. Defaults to `false`.
- `ip_allowlist_enabled` (Boolean) Restrict sign-in and API-key use to `allowed_ip_ranges`. Defaults to `false`. With no ranges set, an enabled allowlist allows everything.
- `session_timeout_minutes` (Number) Idle auto-logout window in minutes, between `5` and `1440`. Left as the server has it when omitted (the platform default is `60`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Tenant ID, which this setting is keyed on.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_tenant_security_settings.this <tenant_id>
```
